task.question: Who won the GCT Super Chess Classic Romania on May 23, 2026?
task.evidence: May 23 – Vincent Keymer won the GCT Super Chess Classic Romania with a score of 6/9. Fabiano Caruana finished second with 5½/9, while Javokhir Sindarov and Wesley So tied for third place with 5/9.
